EIA completed modeling and analysis for this report on Thursday, October 1, 2026.
The approximate break between historical and forecast values is shown with historical data with no shading; estimates and forecasts are shaded gray.
Prices are not adjusted for inflation; prices exclude taxes unless otherwise noted.
Historical data: Latest data available from Energy Information Administration databases supporting the following reports: Petroleum Marketing Monthly;
Weekly Petroleum Status Report; Natural Gas Monthly; Electric Power Monthly;  Monthly Energy Review; Heating Oil and Propoane Update.

WTI and Brent crude oil spot prices, the Mt. Belvieu propane spot price, and the Henry Hub natural gas spot price are from Refinitiv,an LSEG company, via EIA (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/pet_pri_spt_s1_d.htm).
Retail heating oil prices are from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index.
Minor discrepancies with published historical data are due to independent rounding.
Forecasts: EIA Short-Term Integrated Forecasting System.
